name: effects_strongest_applies
description: Team effects never stack; the strongest applies (design 3.2). A Frost Spire (45%) and a Deep Frost (60%) on one Thornback slow it 60%, not 105% or 78%; an Owl's Eye (+20%) and an Owl's Glare (+35%) on it mark it +35%. When the stronger tower goes, its effect lasts out its time and then the weaker one takes hold: the mark drops to +20% a second after the Glare is sold, the slow to 45% once the Deep Frost's last two seconds run out.

steps.msg: a Frost Spire and a Deep Frost; an Owl's Eye and an Owl's Glare
both spires hit it, again and again

steps.assert: scene.creep(c).mark_pm == 350 and scene.creep(c).mark_seat == 2 and scene.creep(c).mark_until > scene.client(1).tick

steps.msg: the Eye's weaker mark never took over from the Glare's
the Glare is sold: its mark lasts out its second
the Deep Frost is sold: its slow lasts out its two seconds
then the Frost Spire's 45% is what slows it: a weaker slow never stretched the stronger one
